quotes: On August 2, 2026, the Company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement,” and the transactions contemplated thereby, the “Transaction”), by and among the Company, Armstrong Parent, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Parent”), and Armstrong Bidco, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent (“Merger Sub”).

material_events.claim: The company received early termination of the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period for the merger. This satisfies one closing condition; other antitrust and foreign direct investment approvals remain.

unknowns: No numeric revenue guidance for 2026 is in the evidence. The 10-K (P3.s19) says only that three new products will weigh on 2026 sales growth, and gives no figure. The Q3 2026 release (P6.s15) says the company is not providing a financial outlook because of the pending KKR merger.

The evidence does not show how long the lower adoption of the two Electrophysiology products and the one Neuromodulation product will last. So it cannot say whether the margin decline seen in 2026 to date will continue into 2027 or later.

The evidence does not show whether or when the merger at $127 per share in cash will close. It says closing is expected by the end of 2026, subject to remaining regulatory approvals and to stockholder lawsuits that seek to enjoin the merger.

The evidence does not show how many 2028 Convertible Notes holders will convert during the conversion period ending December 31, 2026. It also does not say how the company will settle any conversion amount above principal.
